title: ALL ( column ) as a modifier removes the filter, so orphan rows count again
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( 'Product'[Color] ) ) ), 'Product'[Color] = "Red" )

source.quote: This function removes the corresponding filters from the filter context, just as REMOVEFILTERS does.
source.supports: ALL removes the filter from the column

source.quote: when used as a CALCULATE filter, removes a filter. It does not return a table result.
source.supports: as a CALCULATE filter ALL removes a filter and does not return a table

derivation: Under Color = Red the amount is Bike 100. With the filter removed nothing filters Sales: 100 + 30 + 50 + 20 = 200, orphans included.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
